t: You're standing at the Prince of Wales Theatre on Coventry Street, close to Leicester Square. It was established in 1884 and rebuilt in 1937, and in 2004 it was extensively refurbished by its current owner, Sir Cameron Mackintosh. The original theatre was designed by Charles J. Phipps, an architect known for designing more than forty theatres in the second half of the nineteenth century. It shouldn't be confused with the old Scala Theatre, which was also once called the Prince of Wales, and was demolished in 1903.
